- Shortlist: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) looks like the best fit for predictable throughput + private networking.
- Action items we agreed on:

  2) Schedule a technical deep dive with your infra team to validate VPC connectivity and instance sizing — suggested slots below.
  3) You’ll confirm internal stakeholders and budget timeline.

Proposed TD slots (PST): Tue 3/3 10:00–10:30, Wed 3/4 2:00–2:30. Let me know what works.

Attachments: Redwood-Pricing-Q2-v2.pdf, Mutual-Action-Plan-ACME.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
